source: Generated from src/engine/config/killSwitches.js — the §22.5 switch table. tests/engine/configKillSwitches.test.js asserts this file and that table agree in both directions, so the prose here cannot drift from the switch set the engine enforces.
note: Kill-switch states are behavioural configuration like any other value (§22.1 rule 1), so they are register entries. They live in a file rather than being injected at load time so that tools/gates/checkParameterRegister.js — which reads only register/*.json — sees the complete register.

parameters.name: killswitch.reposition_injection
parameters.description: Kill switch for Repositioning. Thrown (true) disables the mechanism and degrades to: No reposition missions. Ships thrown — §1.8 rule 3 launches the Tier 0 + Tier 1 engine and enables Tier 2 mechanisms one at a time, each validated in shadow mode first.

parameters.name: killswitch.preemption
parameters.description: Kill switch for Preemption, including victim disposition. Thrown (true) disables the mechanism and degrades to: Disabled entirely. Ships thrown — §1.8 rule 3 launches the Tier 0 + Tier 1 engine and enables Tier 2 mechanisms one at a time, each validated in shadow mode first.

parameters.name: killswitch.deferral
parameters.description: Kill switch for Deferral as a priced arc. Thrown (true) disables the mechanism and degrades to: Immediate assignment when any feasible candidate exists. Ships thrown — §1.8 rule 3 launches the Tier 0 + Tier 1 engine and enables Tier 2 mechanisms one at a time, each validated in shadow mode first.

parameters.name: killswitch.cross_region_candidacy
parameters.description: Kill switch for Cross-region candidacy. Thrown (true) disables the mechanism and degrades to: Region-local only. Ships thrown — §1.8 rule 3 launches the Tier 0 + Tier 1 engine and enables Tier 2 mechanisms one at a time, each validated in shadow mode first.

parameters.name: killswitch.chaining
parameters.description: Kill switch for Chaining — queue depth > 1. Thrown (true) disables the mechanism and degrades to: capacity[agent_class] = 1; strict one-mission-per-agent. Independent of multi-Leg columns, because queue depth lives in plan feasibility while multi-Leg structure lives in column generation. Ships thrown — §1.8 rule 3 launches the Tier 0 + Tier 1 engine and enables Tier 2 mechanisms one at a time, each validated in shadow mode first.

parameters.name: killswitch.multi_leg_columns
parameters.description: Kill switch for Multi-Leg columns (bundling and consolidation). Thrown (true) disables the mechanism and degrades to: Singleton columns only — which puts every round in the singleton regime, where the solve is a totally unimodular min-cost flow, integral and exact, and solver duals are exact marginal prices. This switch degrades to a *stronger* guarantee, not a weaker one. Ships thrown — §1.8 rule 3 launches the Tier 0 + Tier 1 engine and enables Tier 2 mechanisms one at a time, each validated in shadow mode first.

parameters.name: killswitch.batch_solving
